name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses correctly capture the two requirements: `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)` maps to the requirement to pick up the box on the very next move after a fall, and `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` maps to the requirement to be carrying the box upon reaching the exit. The machine correctly reflects these rules as a rule-only task with no hard goals.
